# DailyCalendarShop

> Wholesale calendar printing in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India. Wall, desk, tent and
> pocket calendars, plus panchangam and cake calendars, sold to dealers and shops
> by design number at trade rates.

Orders are placed from a price list: you type quantities against design numbers,
the running total prices itself, and the estimate becomes an order. Minimum order
values apply and vary by state.

## Ordering

- [Order Now](https://daily.calendarshop.online/order): the full price list — every
  design, its design number, MRP, discount and trade rate.
- [Finished Calendar](https://daily.calendarshop.online/finished-calendar):
  ready-made calendars, sold separately from the printing ranges.
- [Products](https://daily.calendarshop.online/products): the same catalogue as
  individual product pages.

## About

- [About us](https://daily.calendarshop.online/about)
- [Contact](https://daily.calendarshop.online/contact): enquiries and bulk quotes.
- [FAQ](https://daily.calendarshop.online/faq)

## Notes for machine readers

- Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR) and are trade prices, not retail.
- Every product carries a "design number" — the identifier customers quote when
  ordering, shown in the price list and on invoices.
- Product pages publish schema.org Product data including price and live stock
  availability.
- The full URL list is at
  [sitemap.xml](https://daily.calendarshop.online/sitemap.xml).
